title: I Love You, Stupid
short_description: 2020 Spanish romantic comedy drama film directed by Laura Mañá

text.lead: I Love You, Stupid (Spanish: Te quiero, imbécil) is a 2020 Spanish romantic comedy film written and directed by Laura Mañá. The film stars Quim Gutiérrez, Natalia Tena and Alfonso Bassave in the lead roles.
text.plot: Marcos (Quim Gutiérrez), a young man faces series of nightmares after having a breakup with his longtime girlfriend Ana (Alba Ribas) ending an eight year old romantic relationship between the duo. Marcos loses his job on the day after his breakup with Ana and he desperately sets out to reinvent himself and has to revisit the basics of being a modern man with the help of his childhood friend and an Argentinian YouTube guru.
text.cast:
- Quim Gutiérrez as Marcos
- Natalia Tena as Raquel
- Alfonso Bassave as Diego
- Alba Ribas as Ana
- Patricia Vico as Lorena
- Ernesto Alterio as Sebastián Vennet
text.production: The film was produced by Brutal Media, Minoria Absoluta, Lastor Media and Yo hombre la película AIE, with the participation of ICEC, RTVE, TV3 and Netflix.
text.release: Distributed by Filmax, the film was theatrically released in Spain on 24 January 2020. It was also streamed via Netflix on 15 May 2020.
text.reception: The film received mixed reviews from critics. On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, 63% of 8 critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of 5.5/10.
